high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the user "sarahcarpenter," who has a verified account. The post was taken on 6 July 2019 at Central Park. The photo features three individuals posing together in front of a backdrop that includes logos for "Capital One" and "CityParks." People: There are three women standing close to each other. They are all wearing white crop tops and denim shorts with various designs and embellishments. The woman on the left has her hair tied up in a bun and is smiling widely.
